A1.justification: Both complete ten-page PDFs describe the same 3DSR work. Text, equations, figures and tables support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: V1 reports original 3DSR experiments on LLFF and MipNeRF360, including quantitative results in Tables 1–2 and qualitative comparisons in Figures 4–5.

after.justification: V2 retains the original LLFF and MipNeRF360 experiments and their quantitative and qualitative outcomes.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same diffusion sampling, 3D Gaussian fitting and rendering, latent re-encoding, and training losses. Figure 1's revised model labels do not establish a procedure change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same LLFF and MipNeRF360 coverage, including forward-facing views and indoor/outdoor scenes. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SuperGaussian, DiSR-NeRF and StableSR; Table 2 retains SuperGaussian and StableSR. Figure 1 relabels the existing LR-input comparison without adding or replacing a comparator.

E3.justification: The splits, metrics, training budgets and experimental procedures remain unchanged. Table 1's revised caption repeats the ×8 downsampling and ×4 upsampling already stated in Figure 4, rather than documenting a new setting.

E4.justification: The qualitative artifact and geometry comparisons in Figures 2, 4 and 5 are unchanged. Neither version adds ablations, sensitivity analyses or robustness tests.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed details, error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Every numerical entry in Tables 1–2 and all qualitative result images are unchanged. For example, 3DSR PSNR remains 24.212 on LLFF and 26.097 on MipNeRF360.

T1.justification: The diffusion definitions, update derivation and loss equations in Section 3, Equations 1–11, are unchanged. No formal assumption, proposition or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the claims of improved perceptual quality and geometric consistency through diffusion super-resolution combined with an explicit 3D representation, without additional model fine-tuning.

C2.justification: The explanations of hallucinated-detail artifacts, SuperGaussian's difficulty with sparse LLFF views, and 3DSR's geometric consistency remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces 'Code will be released' with a project-page URL, providing a concrete access pointer without establishing code availability. Table 1 removes the explicit 504×378 resolution. Implementation details otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning against prior methods and all 45 numbered reference entries are unchanged.

P1.justification: Limited wording edits clarify Figure 1's terminology, rephrase the table captions and revise the abstract's closing access statement. The section order and main narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 changes its panel labels from '3DSR trained' to '3DGS rendering' and clarifies the LR-input versus 3DSR comparison. Tables 1–2 receive revised captions with minor local layout shifts; figure images and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves clarity by correcting Figure 1's confusing 3DSR/3DGS labels and explicitly identifying the LR-input comparison. The project-page address also improves resource discoverability, although code availability is unverified and Table 1 loses its explicit pixel dimensions. The scientific evidence remains unchanged.
